import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, 'tmp'); sys.path.insert(0, 'submission')
import main as M
from perf2 import build
doc, ncore = build(1000000)
spec = M.validate(doc)
ixpset = frozenset(spec['ixps'])
agg = {}
for path, count in spec['rib']:
    p = M.normalize_path(path, ixpset)
    if len(p) < 2 or len(set(p)) != len(p): continue
    agg[tuple(p)] = agg.get(tuple(p),0)+count
final, rounds = M.peel(list(agg.items()))
core = set()
for p in final:
    for i in range(len(p)-1): core.add(M._canon(p[i],p[i+1]))
order = spec['order']
vi = {tuple(l):i for i,l in enumerate(order)}
occs = M.collect_occurrences(final)
factors = [M.build_factor(tuple(l), occs.get(tuple(l),[]), vi) for l in order]
Z, marg = M.infer(factors, len(order))
print("Z bits:", Z.bit_length(), "Z digits:", len(str(Z)))
# check a query's full computation path
q = spec['queries'][0]
p = M.normalize_path(q[1], ixpset)
vecs = []
def lookup(a,b):
    key = M._canon(a,b)
    if key in vi:
        nums = marg[vi[key]]
        return tuple(M.Fraction(x, Z) for x in nums)
    return M.UNIFORM
vecs = [lookup(p[i], p[i+1]) for i in range(len(p)-1)]
bits = sum(max(x.numerator.bit_length()+x.denominator.bit_length() for x in v) for v in vecs)
print("query link count:", len(vecs), "estimated bits:", bits, "-> exact path used:", bits <= 6000)
t = M.compute_full(vecs)
print("full:", t)
